title: PBR Outlaw Days
location: T-Mobile Center, 1407 Grand Blvd, Kansas City, MO
description: The Kansas City Outlaws today announced that their annual PBR Teams league homestand, PBR Outlaw Days presented by Bad Boy Mowersand Tractors, will return to T-Mobile Center for the 2026 season on October 23-25, 2026. The crucial 2026 PBR Teams regular season finale will set the field for the Championship weekend in Las Vegas.  Outlaw Days is anchored by a three-day street festival featuring a range of free-to-attend fun family entertainment.“It’s a privilege for the Outlaws to host this marque event on our home dirt– deciding a regular season champion and league MVP, while setting the crucial playoff seedings,” said Chief Marketing Officer Nicole Capolino. “Every second of every ride during Outlaw Days inside T-Mobile Center will carry extra urgency and drama. We can’t wait to host fans for all the thrilling action and surrounding festivities. Come and show PBR where the loudest fans in the country are and cheer on the Outlaws.”One of two professional bull riding teams in the state of Missouri, the Outlaws host their annual homestead for the fourth straight year. One of the founding teams, Kansas City competes in the PBR Teams league, which transforms bull riding from an individual to team-formatted competition in head-to-head, five-on-five games leading to an annual championship.Led by the 2002 PBR Worlds Finals event winner and bull-riding legend J.W. Hart, the Outlaws look to make another run for their second regular-season title and first Teams Championship. Assistant Coach Guilherme Marchi brings a wealth of experience as well, boasting the 2008 World Championship Buckle on his resume.Cassio Dias, the 2024 World Champion and Rookie of the Year in individual competition, aims to help lift the Kansas City Outlaws to the top after missing most of the 2025 Teams season due to injury. After having just five outs in 2025, Dias still has a riding percentage of 63.0 (43-for-68) over three years in the Teams league and currently ranked seventh in the world.Koltin Hevalow finished fifth in the 2025 MVP Race with 1,617.75 points, going 19-for-34 (55.88%). Hevalow recorded a 90-point ride for the Outlaws on Sucker Pop during Ridge Rider Days and put up 87.75 on Buck during the Teams Championship Last-Chance Game.Joining Dias and Hevalow on the roster are Sandro Batista, Maikon Calixto, Eric Henrique Domingos, Heitor Santos Ferreira, Alison Trindade dos Santos, and Pablo Soares.PBR Teams League event attendance continued to increase in the 2025 season. The bull riding games reached 3 million people when airing on CBS and CW on the same weekend, for a record high 28.2 million total fans reached in 2025. Even with a ranker pen of bulls, the on-the-dirt product has never been better, demonstrated in overall league riding percentage of 42.13 percent in 2025. The competition was fierce throughout the entire season, and another Championship was decided in the final outs of the Championship game to crown the Carolina Cowboys as the 2025 winner.    The bull riding action for the 2026 PBR Team Series’ Outlaw Days presented by Bad Boy Mowers and Tractors at T-Mobile Center begins at 7:45 p.m. CT on Friday, October 23, 6:45 p.m. CT Saturday, October 24, and 1:45 p.m. CT on Sunday, October 25. Prior to each day’s action, the Outlaw Days Festival will open at 4 p.m. Friday, 12 p.m. on Saturday, and 11 a.m. on Sunday morning.Tickets for the 2026 Teams regular season finale in Kansas City are currently on sale and can be purchased HERE, online at KansasCityOutlaws.com, AXS.com, and PBR.com, at the T-Mobile Center Box Office, or by calling PBR customer service at (800) 732-1727.There are many different options available and include three-day ticket packages offering fans a 15% discount on select price levels.Connect with the Kansas City Outlaws on social media at @KCOutlawsPBR on Facebook, @KCOutlawsPBR on X, @KCOutlawsPBR on Instagram, and @KCOutlawsPBR on TikTok. About the Kansas City Outlaws:The Kansas City Outlaws are based in Kansas City, Missouri at T-Mobile Center, where the team will hold its fourth Outlaw Days homestand on October 23-25, 2026, the 11th final event 2026PBR Teams regular season. The team is coached by J.W. Hart, known as “The Ironman,” and 2008 PBR World Champion Guilherme Marchi. Fans can find more information about the KC Outlaws by visiting www.pbr.com/teams/kansas-city-outlaws/ or @KCOutlawsPBR onFacebook, Instagram, and Twitter. The KC Outlaws are under the leadership of General Manager Jon Williams, and the ownership group led by Phil Pulley that includes Lennie Foree and Ryland Kieffer. These three entrepreneurs have always been rule-breakers at heart. They were among the founders of Bad Boy Mowers, the brand that changed the zero-turn lawnmower game forever. They are currently riding into stores with Outlaw Snax, a snack brand with the boldest flavors on this side of the chip aisle and an attitude bringing their same drive to succeed to the PBR Team Series. For more information on Outlaw Snax, visit www.outlawsnax.com or @OutlawSnax onFacebook, Instagram, and X.   About PBR Teams:PBR Teams is an elite league featuring the world’s top bull riders competing on teams in five-on-five games leading to a Team Championship at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas. During the 2026 season, the league’s fifth, each of the 10 teams – Austin Gamblers of Austin, TX; Arizona Ridge Riders of Glendale, AZ; Carolina Cowboys of Greensboro, NC; Florida Freedom of Sunrise, FL; Kansas City Outlaws of Kansas City, MO; Nashville Stampede of Nashville, TN; New York Mavericks of Brooklyn, NY; OK; Oklahoma Wildcatters of Oklahoma City, OK; Missouri Thunder of Springfield, MO; and Texas Rattlers of Fort Worth, TX– will host a homestand. Neutral-site games in locations to be announced are planned as well.PBR Teams, launched in July 2022, builds on the existing structure of professional bull riding with the same basic rules for judging and scoring qualified 8-second bull rides. In events staged in a tournament-style format, all teams compete in head-to-head matchups against a different opponent each day. Each game features five riders per team squaring off against another team. Full team rosters are comprised of seven riders on the Protected Roster and five Reserve riders. The team with the highest aggregate score of qualified rides among its riders is declared the winner of each game.PBR is part of TKO, a global sports and entertainment company. For more information, visit PBR.com, or follow on Facebook at Facebook.com/PBR, Twitter at Twitter.com/PBR, and YouTube at YouTube.com/PBR.DON’T WAIT FOR DOORS TO OPEN.The party starts early at the FREE Outlaw Days FanFest at KC L!ve on Grand Street! Join us before the bucking for live music, rider meet & greets, giveaways, line dancing and more — all just steps from T-Mobile Center.

description: The Kansas City Outlaws today announced that their annual PBR Teams league homestand, PBR Outlaw Days presented by Bad Boy Mowersand Tractors, will return to T-Mobile Center for the 2026 season on October 23-25, 2026. The crucial 2026 PBR Teams regular season finale will set the field for the Championship weekend in Las Vegas.  Outlaw Days is anchored by a three-day street festival featuring a range of free-to-attend fun family entertainment.“It’s a privilege for the Outlaws to host this marque event on our home dirt– deciding a regular season champion and league MVP, while setting the crucial playoff seedings,” said Chief Marketing Officer Nicole Capolino. “Every second of every ride during Outlaw Days inside T-Mobile Center will carry extra urgency and drama. We can’t wait to host fans for all the thrilling action and surrounding festivities. Come and show PBR where the loudest fans in the country are and cheer on the Outlaws.”One of two professional bull riding teams in the state of Missouri, the Outlaws host their annual homestead for the fourth straight year. One of the founding teams, Kansas City competes in the PBR Teams league, which transforms bull riding from an individual to team-formatted competition in head-to-head, five-on-five games leading to an annual championship.Led by the 2002 PBR Worlds Finals event winner and bull-riding legend J.W. Hart, the Outlaws look to make another run for their second regular-season title and first Teams Championship. Assistant Coach Guilherme Marchi brings a wealth of experience as well, boasting the 2008 World Championship Buckle on his resume.Cassio Dias, the 2024 World Champion and Rookie of the Year in individual competition, aims to help lift the Kansas City Outlaws to the top after missing most of the 2025 Teams season due to injury. After having just five outs in 2025, Dias still has a riding percentage of 63.0 (43-for-68) over three years in the Teams league and currently ranked seventh in the world.Koltin Hevalow finished fifth in the 2025 MVP Race with 1,617.75 points, going 19-for-34 (55.88%). Hevalow recorded a 90-point ride for the Outlaws on Sucker Pop during Ridge Rider Days and put up 87.75 on Buck during the Teams Championship Last-Chance Game.Joining Dias and Hevalow on the roster are Sandro Batista, Maikon Calixto, Eric Henrique Domingos, Heitor Santos Ferreira, Alison Trindade dos Santos, and Pablo Soares.PBR Teams League event attendance continued to increase in the 2025 season. The bull riding games reached 3 million people when airing on CBS and CW on the same weekend, for a record high 28.2 million total fans reached in 2025. Even with a ranker pen of bulls, the on-the-dirt product has never been better, demonstrated in overall league riding percentage of 42.13 percent in 2025. The competition was fierce throughout the entire season, and another Championship was decided in the final outs of the Championship game to crown the Carolina Cowboys as the 2025 winner.    The bull riding action for the 2026 PBR Team Series’ Outlaw Days presented by Bad Boy Mowers and Tractors at T-Mobile Center begins at 7:45 p.m. CT on Friday, October 23, 6:45 p.m. CT Saturday, October 24, and 1:45 p.m. CT on Sunday, October 25. Prior to each day’s action, the Outlaw Days Festival will open at 4 p.m. Friday, 12 p.m. on Saturday, and 11 a.m. on Sunday morning.Tickets for the 2026 Teams regular season finale in Kansas City are currently on sale and can be purchased HERE, online at KansasCityOutlaws.com, AXS.com, and PBR.com, at the T-Mobile Center Box Office, or by calling PBR customer service at (800) 732-1727.There are many different options available and include three-day ticket packages offering fans a 15% discount on select price levels.Connect with the Kansas City Outlaws on social media at @KCOutlawsPBR on Facebook, @KCOutlawsPBR on X, @KCOutlawsPBR on Instagram, and @KCOutlawsPBR on TikTok. About the Kansas City Outlaws:The Kansas City Outlaws are based in Kansas City, Missouri at T-Mobile Center, where the team will hold its fourth Outlaw Days homestand on October 23-25, 2026, the 11th final event 2026PBR Teams regular season. The team is coached by J.W. Hart, known as “The Ironman,” and 2008 PBR World Champion Guilherme Marchi. Fans can find more information about the KC Outlaws by visiting www.pbr.com/teams/kansas-city-outlaws/ or @KCOutlawsPBR onFacebook, Instagram, and Twitter. The KC Outlaws are under the leadership of General Manager Jon Williams, and the ownership group led by Phil Pulley that includes Lennie Foree and Ryland Kieffer. These three entrepreneurs have always been rule-breakers at heart. They were among the founders of Bad Boy Mowers, the brand that changed the zero-turn lawnmower game forever. They are currently riding into stores with Outlaw Snax, a snack brand with the boldest flavors on this side of the chip aisle and an attitude bringing their same drive to succeed to the PBR Team Series. For more information on Outlaw Snax, visit www.outlawsnax.com or @OutlawSnax onFacebook, Instagram, and X.   About PBR Teams:PBR Teams is an elite league featuring the world’s top bull riders competing on teams in five-on-five games leading to a Team Championship at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas. During the 2026 season, the league’s fifth, each of the 10 teams – Austin Gamblers of Austin, TX; Arizona Ridge Riders of Glendale, AZ; Carolina Cowboys of Greensboro, NC; Florida Freedom of Sunrise, FL; Kansas City Outlaws of Kansas City, MO; Nashville Stampede of Nashville, TN; New York Mavericks of Brooklyn, NY; OK; Oklahoma Wildcatters of Oklahoma City, OK; Missouri Thunder of Springfield, MO; and Texas Rattlers of Fort Worth, TX– will host a homestand. Neutral-site games in locations to be announced are planned as well.PBR Teams, launched in July 2022, builds on the existing structure of professional bull riding with the same basic rules for judging and scoring qualified 8-second bull rides. In events staged in a tournament-style format, all teams compete in head-to-head matchups against a different opponent each day. Each game features five riders per team squaring off against another team. Full team rosters are comprised of seven riders on the Protected Roster and five Reserve riders. The team with the highest aggregate score of qualified rides among its riders is declared the winner of each game.PBR is part of TKO, a global sports and entertainment company. For more information, visit PBR.com, or follow on Facebook at Facebook.com/PBR, Twitter at Twitter.com/PBR, and YouTube at YouTube.com/PBR.DON’T WAIT FOR DOORS TO OPEN.The party starts early at the FREE Outlaw Days FanFest at KC L!ve on Grand Street! Join us before the bucking for live music, rider meet & greets, giveaways, line dancing and more — all just steps from T-Mobile Center.
